snippet.title: Eleven - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 Welcome to Eleven – The Ultimate Space Shooter! 🔥

Gear up, pilot! Eleven is a fast-paced space multiplayer shooter where YOU command the battlefield. Dominate the stars in three adrenaline-fueled game modes:
⚔️ Team Deathmatch – Squad up and wipe out the enemy.
💀 Kill Confirmed – Eliminate targets and secure victory with each confirmed kill.
🚪 Gates – Strategic, objective-based warfare that demands skill and teamwork.

With over 1 MILLION ways to customize your ship – from thrusters to decals – you’ll never see two ships alike. Whether you’re a lone wolf or a team player, Eleven delivers intense combat and jaw-dropping visuals.

🎮 Coming to Epic Games, Steam, Google Play, and the App Store.
🚀 Cross-platform matchmaking. Zero pay-to-win. Pure skill.

👾 Join the community: https://discord.gg/pWzXWAtrHT
🌌 Wishlist now and prepare to conquer the cosmos.

#ElevenGame #GameplayTrailer #SpaceShooter #Multiplayer #IndieGame #EpicGames #Steam
